weightedAverageMaturityDays.rationale: IAUon is a total-return tracker on the iShares Gold Trust (IAU) equity/ETF exposure, not a fixed-income credit portfolio with a maturity ladder. Gold bullion / equity-ETF trackers have no portfolio weighted-average maturity in the credit-fund sense. Dual-source: Ondo overview (tokenized stocks/ETFs as total return trackers) + important notes (economic exposure to underlying ETF, not a debt instrument).

valuationCadenceDays.rationale: Trust & Transparency docs: daily attestations of holdings by independent verification/security agent Ankura Trust Company; daily NAV/holdings reports; monthly reconciliations by the 20th of the following month; annual independent audits. valuationCadenceDays=1 from the daily attestation/NAV commitment. Dual-source: trust-and-transparency page + overview investor-protection summary.

creditQuality.basis: Underlying is iShares Gold Trust (IAU), a large, publicly traded gold ETF. Ondo token provides economic exposure to that ETF plus reinvested dividends (net of withholding) as a total-return tracker, fully backed by underlying assets plus cash in transit (overview + important notes). Adequate: public underlying with continuous market pricing; grade is not 'strong' because the token is not the ETF share itself and depends on Ondo GM operational performance.

seniority.basis: Tokenholders benefit from a first-priority perfected security interest in collateral held by third-party security agent Ankura Trust Company, with authority to take possession, liquidate, and distribute on specified issuer default events (trust-and-transparency). Dual-source: security-interest description + bankruptcy-remote SPV structure. Adequate structural seniority vs issuer creditors; not a direct ETF custody claim.

legalEnforceability.basis: Issuer Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited is a bankruptcy-remote SPV with independent director, segregated assets, and service relationship to Ondo Finance Inc. (important notes + trust-and-transparency). Prospectus/offering docs for qualified purchasers; EEA base prospectus path referenced. Tokens are not registered US securities for US persons. Adequate documented legal architecture for non-US eligible investors.

valuationCadence.basis: Daily Ankura attestations and daily NAV/holdings reports plus monthly reconciliations and annual audits (trust-and-transparency). Instant mint/burn against platform quotes during market hours (overview). Adequate independent daily cadence.

maturityAndLiquidity.basis: Underlying IAU is exchange-traded gold exposure with deep secondary markets; Ondo designs instant atomic mint/redeem for KYC institutional participants and 24/5 trading with optional Off-Hours session (overview + important notes Off-Hours risks). No credit maturity. Adequate liquidity design with disclosed off-hours limitations.

custody.basis: Underlying holdings at one or more US-registered custodial broker-dealers with daily Ankura verification (trust-and-transparency). Dual-source: custody statement + independent verification agent role. Adequate institutional custody path.

recovery.basis: Security agent enforcement path on issuer default; overcollateralization requirement above full backing; contractual insurance fund from Ondo Foundation/Flux Finance subsidiary guaranteeing additional collateralization (trust-and-transparency). Dual-source within the same primary transparency page plus overview investor-protection summary. Adequate documented recovery tools; not strong without a public measured insurance-fund balance pin.
